It enters long when RSI crosses above a buy threshold, the trend direction is positive, TEMA is below the Bollinger middle band and rising, and volume is positive. It exits when RSI crosses above a sell threshold while TEMA is above the middle band and falling, with minimal ROI, a -20% stoploss, and trailing stop enabled.

Sar trades 5-minute candles. It enters long when RSI crosses above 30, TEMA is below the Bollinger middle band and rising, and volume is positive. It exits when RSI crosses above 70 while TEMA is above the middle band and falling; stoploss is -10% and no trailing stop is used.

Saturn5 trades 15-minute candles and has three optional long setups. It buys dips when price is below long EMAs or lower Bollinger/fib bands, or when shorter EMAs cross up while price is below the long EMA; it does not use sell signals and exits via a 5% ROI or -20% stoploss.

Saturn5_1 trades 15-minute candles and has three optional long setups. It buys dips when price is below long EMAs or lower Bollinger/fib bands, or when shorter EMAs cross up while the close is above the long EMA but the low is below it; it does not use sell signals and exits via a 5% ROI or -20% stoploss.

SaulusStrategia uses 5-minute candles. It enters long when RSI is below 30 and an SMA20/SMA80 comparison is less than EMA5. It exits when RSI is above 50 and an SMA20/SMA80 comparison is greater than EMA5, with a 1% minimal ROI and -10% stoploss.

SaulusStrategiaOtimizeHyperOpt uses 5-minute candles. It enters long when RSI is below 30 and an SMA20/SMA80 comparison is less than EMA5. It exits when RSI is above 50 and an SMA20/SMA80 comparison is greater than EMA5, with a stepped minimal ROI ladder and -27.8% stoploss.

Scalp trades 1-minute candles. It enters long when the open is below the 5-period EMA low, ADX is above 30, and fast stochastic %K and %D are below 30 with %K crossing above %D. It exits when the open is at or above the EMA high or stochastic crosses above 70; ROI is 1% and stoploss is -4%.

ScalpV1 trades 1-minute candles. It exits when the open is above the EMA high and optional oscillator/ADX conditions hold; ROI is 2% and stoploss is -10%.

description.text: On the 5m timeframe, it enters long when the bearish fractal pattern is active, close is below the Alligator teeth, and volume is positive. On a 5m timeframe, this strategy computes Alligator lips/jaw/teeth and fractal-like bearish/bullish conditions from shifted highs and lows. It buys when the bearish condition is true, close is below the Alligator teeth, and volume is positive, and it sells when the bullish condition is true, close is above teeth, and volume is positive. It uses a -0.2 stoploss and a decaying minimal ROI, with trailing stop disabled.

Exit is a close crossing below the lower Bollinger band with an optional MFI condition, or sell signals are suppressed when sell_hold is enabled.

It buys when MACD is above zero and above signal, the upper Bollinger band is rising, and the selected RSI is above the buy threshold. It exits when the selected RSI is above the sell threshold, with a -0.25 stoploss and 1% minimal ROI.

On a 1d timeframe, this strategy can short. It uses fixed MACD, a selected RSI period from a range, and Bollinger bands. It enters short when MACD is below zero and below signal, the upper Bollinger band is declining, and the selected RSI is below the short-buy threshold. It exits short when the selected RSI is above the sell-short threshold, with a -0.10 stoploss and 1% minimal ROI.

description.text: On 5m candles, it enters long when price is below an EMA offset, EWO is in a configured range and rising, and RSI/fast RSI are below their buy thresholds. It exits on strength above HMA50 and a sell EMA offset with RSI above 50 and fast RSI above slow RSI, or an alternate close/HMA condition. It has a -25% stoploss, an ROI table, and position adjustment hooks.

On 5m candles, it enters long when price is below an EMA offset, EWO is in a configured range and rising, and RSI/fast RSI are below their buy thresholds. It exits on strength above HMA50 and a sell EMA offset with RSI above 50 and fast RSI above slow RSI, or an alternate close/HMA condition. It has a -25% stoploss, an ROI table, and custom entry price, sell, stoploss, and adjustment hooks.

On 5m candles, it buys dips below an EMA offset when EWO is above a threshold, RSI and fast RSI are low, and vol_base is below -80, with a pump-protection filter. It exits when price is above SMA9 and a sell EMA offset with RSI above 50, or under an alternate lower-HMA condition. It uses a -15% stoploss, trailing stop, and ROI.

On 5m candles, it buys when price is below the shifted lower Bollinger band with band/close delta and candle-tail filters while EMA10 is above EMA100, or when price is below 0.993 of the lower band and volume is below a slow average. It exits on SMA9/sell-EMA strength with RSI above 50 and fast RSI above slow RSI, or under an alternate lower-HMA condition. It uses a -15% stoploss, trailing stop, and ROI.

On 30m candles, it enters long when close is above a rising 23-period SMA and RSI is above its 50-period average and above 50. It exits when slow stochastic crosses down from above 75 or when close makes a new 100-bar low. It has a -25% stoploss and no ROI exit.

On 4h candles, it enters long when close is above a rising 23-period SMA and RSI is above its 50-period average and above 66. It exits when slow stochastic crosses down from above 75 or when close makes a new 100-bar low. It has a -32% stoploss and no ROI exit.

On 1h candles, it enters when WaveTrend wave_t1 crosses above wave_t2 and is rising, or when RSI crosses above its moving average within configured RSI bounds. It exits when RSI/WaveTrend cross down after RSI is above the sell threshold. It has a -40% stoploss, trailing stop, ROI, and position adjustment up to 2.

On 1h candles, it enters when RSI is above its moving average and within the configured buy range, while WaveTrend wave_t1 is rising and crosses above wave_t2. It exits when RSI is above the sell threshold and WaveTrend wave_t2 crosses above wave_t1. It has a -40% stoploss, trailing stop, ROI, and position adjustment up to 3.

On 15m candles, it buys when price is below the lower Bollinger band with RSI above 35, or below the middle band with RSI below 62. There is no sell signal in the exit code, so exits rely on ROI and the custom stoploss hook. It has a -99% stoploss and a multi-step minimal ROI.

On 15m candles, it buys when RSI is below 35 and close is below the lower Bollinger band. There is no sell signal in the exit code, so exits rely on ROI and the custom stoploss hook. It has a -99% stoploss and a single 10% minimal ROI target.
